title: Aspect: Wyvern Talons, the stoop
note: Design doc §2: the Wyvern's claws come from hind talons on dives. It pays with position. Its Leap climbs two bands, and aloft it closes to Close. Next exchange, a Claw from the air stoops: it descends to the ground, carrying at most a band, and swipes both ways. The fall from two bands takes time, so the Claw comes late (tick 18). Brine strafes, and the late Claw catches it in its recovery for a punish. Landed, the Wyvern is in Bite range.
